stories.title: Health Endpoint Schema and Response Contract
stories.description: Define the /health response schema including status (ok/degraded/down), timestamp, version/build info, and optional dependency checks (e.g., MongoDB connectivity). Ensure contract is minimal, deterministic, and safe for public exposure.

stories.title: Health Check Core Logic Implementation
stories.description: Implement backend logic to evaluate system health including application uptime, basic dependency reachability (e.g., MongoDB ping via shared utilities), and internal readiness state. Ensure logic is lightweight and non-blocking.

stories.title: Expose /health FastAPI Endpoint
stories.description: Add a GET /health endpoint in main.py that returns the standardized health response. Ensure no authentication required, fast response time, and compatibility with Azure App Service health probes.

stories.title: Health Endpoint Unit and Integration Tests
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests validating /health response structure, status transitions (healthy vs degraded), and dependency failure handling. Ensure endpoint responds within acceptable latency and does not trigger side effects.
